crossRefs.note: “You are the salt of the earth, but if the salt has lost its flavor, with what will it be salted? It is then good for…
For everyone will be salted with fire, and every sacrifice will be seasoned with salt.
Salt is good, but if the salt has lost its saltiness, with what will you season it? Have salt in yourselves, and be at…
Let your speech always be with grace, seasoned with salt, that you may know how you ought to answer each one.
God also testifying with them, both by signs and wonders, by various works of power and by gifts of the Holy Spirit…

translations.web: Salt is good, but if the salt becomes flat and tasteless, with what do you season it?
translations.bsb: Salt is good, but if the salt loses its savor, with what will it be seasoned?
translations.kjv: Salt is good: but if the salt have lost his savour, wherewith shall it be seasoned?
translations.asv: Salt therefore is good: but if even the salt have lost its savor, wherewith shall it be seasoned?
